title: Biglari Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Biglari Holdings Inc. filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on April 8, 2026, disclosing the results of its Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on that date. All director nominees were elected, and the selection of Deloitte & Touche LLP as the company's independent registered public accounting firm for 2026 was ratified.
key_points: Biglari Holdings held its Annual Meeting of Shareholders on April 8, 2026
Total Class A shares voted: 200,129 out of 211,176 outstanding (approximately 95% turnout)
All five director nominees elected: Sardar Biglari, Philip L. Cooley, Kenneth R. Cooper, John G. Cardwell, and Ruth J. Person
Each director received between 168,605 and 171,200 'for' votes
There were 7,763 broker non-votes in the director elections
Deloitte & Touche LLP was ratified as the company's independent auditor for 2026 with 198,645 votes for, 1,261 against, and 197 abstentions
